title: Why MAX_ROWS streaming is required
pdf_question: The real dataset contains ~1.38 million reviews across ~25,000 books and ~19,000 users, totaling ~17.6 million sentences. Why would loading a file this large directly into memory as a Python list be risky on a typical laptop? What strategy did we use to load it safely (see the MAX_ROWS variable)?
graph_structure: Two horizontal bars: reviews kept vs reviews left unread on disk
